  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(gross_amount - ROUND(net_amount * (1 + vat_rate), 2)) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mismatched_lines
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
  AND channel_code = 'ST'

SELECT 
  ROUND(vat_rate * 100, 1) AS vat_rate_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged_eur
FROM fact_sales_line

  AND channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY vat_rate
ORDER BY vat_rate
